scope: Existing normal-mode app integration and SDK coexistence. This app combines explicit SwiftUI tracking and a custom UIKit predicate; it cannot certify automatic-only C07-C10.

journeys.name: Logged-out login and lifecycle
dependencies: Separate bounded runtime definition and oracle admission
journeys.environment: Two fresh task-owned Duo27.1 simulators, one baseline and one candidate installation, Xcode27.1-built Debug apps; no credentials
sequence: Launch once with --rum-release-validation and prove logged-out Login UI
Tap existing Log In with Subdomain once; prove subdomain form
Tap existing Back once; prove default login form
Background once and activate same process once; prove restored login UI
Finish native evidence, allow bounded upload, then remove task app/simulator
journeys.decisive_test: Native state transitions succeed. Exact LoginView exists and one LoginWithSubdomainTapped belongs to its active view ID/session. Preserve complete service/session inventory and compare source-bound baseline/candidate lifecycle ownership and counts; no required manual Back action and no guessed background view-ID churn.

journeys.name: Service list/detail and authenticated lifecycle
journeys.owner: SDK implementer; user supplies interactive login if required
dependencies: Frozen exact mixed-instrumentation inventory before inputs
journeys.environment: Same qualified simulator/app pair; authorized read-only organization data
sequence: Background and foreground the same authenticated process
journeys.decisive_test: Exact manual ServiceList/ServiceDetail owner relationships, unchanged action/resource completion inventory and request-start ownership. The hosting controllers also have legacy predicate labels Services/ServiceDetails; resolve expected overlap before execution rather than accepting arbitrary names.

journeys.name: Dashboard WebView owner beyond cache TTL
journeys.owner: SDK implementer; user supplies interactive login if required
journeys.environment: Same qualified simulator/app pair with one read-only accessible dashboard
sequence: Keep its native owner attached beyond the frozen baseline cache TTL of three minutes
Produce one existing browser interaction and capture complete correlation evidence
journeys.decisive_test: Native DashboardDetails owner remains valid for browser telemetry after the TTL; no missing, stale or foreign owner, with complete baseline/candidate event inventories.

journeys.name: Internal TestFlight evaluation
dependencies: Qualified candidate and completed local journeys
journeys.environment: Internal TestFlight on eligible physical device
journeys.decisive_test: Finite ordinary-journey outcome and crash/non-disruption evaluation on the distributed exact candidate.

shared_binding: Fresh simulator identity and clean installation; verify full installed bundle against frozen manifest
Source revision, static SDK linkage, sdk.version, bundle ID and host start/end timestamps
Pre-run service inventory and exactly one fresh non-restored RUM session per arm; ambiguous ownership fails closed
Complete raw service/session pagination; bounded ingestion waits; preserve failed or partial outcomes
No copied credentials, source edits, rebuilds, input retries, TestFlight upload or Replay-content qualification
